decisions.decision: No overnight soak gate for this open-source project.
decisions.rationale: Owner direction on 2026-09-18: long-run behaviour on real machines comes from user feedback and crash reports; bounded real-time soak plus scale matrix and rollback rehearsal are the final resource criteria.

decisions.decision: Post-closure fixes were shipped outside Pyramid.
decisions.rationale: The closed plan's evidence must not be presented as covering later changes; the fixes carry their own tests, verifier runs and CONTEXT.md record.

decisions.decision: Notarize through the Xcode upload route, not notarytool credentials.
decisions.rationale: The Apple ID app-specific password failed with HTTP 401; the Xcode route needs no stored credential and Apple accepted both releases within about two minutes.

assumptions: Signing stays with Developer ID Application for Team G3P6TU385Y and the profile named 'Disk Steward Developer ID Distribution'.
The next release bumps CFBundleVersion to 7 in Config/Packaging/project.yml and keeps DiskSteward-Info.plist synchronized.
risks: The installed app's scan generation started 2026-09-18T11:01Z and is still active on 2026-09-20T02:09Z. It reports 16,805,758 processed entries for about 100,000 files with 1,568 directories pending, and retention has now forced one eviction. No complete generation exists since 2026-09-13, so 'last complete scan' stays stale. This is an open observation about the live store, not a regression proven by any test.
FIND-ATTRIBUTION and FIND-DISTRIBUTION-DOC remain open medium findings inside the closed plan, documented and not material to its gates.
Isolated-verifier evidence directories for the 1.2.x releases lived under /private/tmp and were deleted; only the archived evidence inside docs/reliability/evidence and the release hashes remain.
next_steps: If the stale 'last complete scan' matters, investigate why the generation re-enumerates so many entries before completing; start from MetadataScanDirectoryCursor and DirectoryStreamRegistry restart handling and the retention pressure path.
If the post-closure fixes need a Pyramid record, start a new intent with `pyramid-task:new-intent`; never reopen the closed plan for them.
For the next release, follow CONTEXT.md: bump the build, verify in isolation, archive, upload, poll `xcodebuild -exportNotarizedApp`, then publish.
